Nout.note: Nout v: the out-neighbourhood [set w | v --> w] of a vertex of a finite digraph; a loop makes v its own out-neighbour; no looplessness, connectivity or inhabited-carrier premise; outdeg v = #|Nout v| by conversion; the converse digraph swaps it with Nin.

Nin.note: Nin v: the in-neighbourhood [set u | u --> v]; a loop makes v its own in-neighbour; B16's indeg v = #|Nin v| by conversion; the converse digraph swaps it with Nout.

Nout2.note: Nout2 v: the second out-neighbourhood, the vertices w at directed distance exactly two: w != v, w is not an out-neighbour of v, and some out-neighbour u of v has u --> w. Both exclusions are kept even when a loop or a digon gives a walk of length two back to v or to an out-neighbour (Nout2_neq, Nout2_notin_Nout, digon_notin_Nout2).

diregular.note: diregular D d: the Boolean [forall v : D, (outdeg v == d) && (indeg v == d)], out-degree conjunct first as in its source; vacuous on the empty carrier for every d (diregular_card0); a loop counts once on each side; an arcless digraph is 0-diregular; implies balanced (diregular_balanced); invariant under the converse.
